description: Search Prax threat intelligence in plain words (e.g. 'critical attacker wallets on base this week', 'phishing contracts created by 0x...'). Returns COUNTS of matching addresses (by band, chain, role) plus approved alerts from the last 24 h; address lists are not enumerable - look a specific address up with screen_wallet. Filters: chain (eth, base...), risk band (critical, high), role (attacker wallet, malicious contract, deployer, funding ancestry, clone), period (today, last 7 days, since 2026-10-01), free text (bytecode clone, phishing), 'created by 0x...', 'counterparties of 0x...'. An exact address or tx hash returns that record's id. Use fetch(id) for the full record. Business plan and above.
name: search
title: Search Prax intel
